title: locale.json
description: Ops-owned locale identity. One per locale pack. Reference values from locales/es (plan §2.2).

code.description: Locale code, e.g. 'es','fr','nl','en'. Must equal the folder name.

schema_version.description: Pack schema version; bump on breaking key changes (see CHANGELOG).

odoo_lang.description: Odoo read-context language / skill-type token language, e.g. 'es_ES'.

fallback.description: UI-STRING-only fallback locale. en packs may set 'en'; es sets null (engine base). NEVER a fallback for pricing/fiscal/product ids.

output_language.description: Instruction passed to the copy LLM, e.g. 'español correcto (acentos y ñ, del/al, tú)'.

pack_status.description: reference=complete language/fiscal FRAME (language + jurisdiction structure authored), entity/pricing filled per deployment; runtime + onboarding fields MAY be placeholders (en is the reference pack); live=validated production pack (onboarding-required fields MUST be real); stub=schema-valid placeholder blocked from production by the loader. NOTE: es is authored complete as the byte-parity regression oracle but is flagged stub (unverified/blocked from production).
